resources.string: Lets the Local Phone Operator AI read what is on your screen and tap, type, scroll and navigate apps for you. Required for screen vision and hands-free task execution. In Chat + Tasks, a fresh screenshot and UI text are sent to your selected API provider.

Only during Chat + Tasks requests, Local Phone Operator captures the current app window and reads UI elements. The image and UI text are sent to your selected API provider. Final send, delete and payment actions need confirmation. Chat never reads or controls your phone. Stop ends the run. Authentication screens are blocked.
